chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a free man who marries a slave girl of a group of people, are the children slaves or free? He said: If one of the parents is free, then the children are free.
A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, similar to it.
ai.seo_question: Are children free or slaves if one parent is free and the other is a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'freeing by one parent' (إمالة), ruling that a child born to a free man and a slave woman is free, reflecting the Shia legal preference for emancipation. It highlights the juristic consensus that the free status of one parent overrides the slave status of the other, ensuring the child's social and legal freedom.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the free man marrying a slave girl of a group of people, would the children be slaves or free ones?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it was such that one of its parents was free, so the children would be free ones’.
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Abu Umeyr – similar to it.
